title: Ship View Manifest
description: Schema for .ship/views/<name>/manifest.json — declares a Ship HTML view's identity, data sources, and event subscriptions.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Set to this schema's $id for editor validation.

name.description: View identifier. Must match the directory name under .ship/views/.

type.description: View rendering type. Only 'html' is supported today.

description.description: Human-readable description of the view's purpose. Shown in Studio listings.

title.description: Page title override. Defaults to the view name when absent.

icon.description: Optional icon hint for Studio navigation. Free-form string.

data.description: Data sources the view requires at render time.

collections.description: Collection IDs whose items are injected into the view template context.

events.description: Event types the view subscribes to. Matching events trigger SSE re-renders. Examples: 'collection.item_created', 'workspace.started'.
